scope: Independent local review of committed90724fe only; no provider/GitHub/network calls; no candidate policy or uncommitted experimental outcomes used; no existing blind-review conclusion files read before assessment. Compiler check supplied by coordinator and independently hash-verified.
assessment: Strong, broadly compliant submission with substantial reproducible implementation and candid evaluation. I would not yet confidently recommend A+: personal review/submission duties remain unverified, drift governance needs explicit current-scope disposition, and historical validity/current hosted assurance have real limits. No numeric grade/rubric is inferred and no grade is guaranteed.
assignment_minimums_vs_self_imposed: 25 original real cases, four explicit skip cases, five attacks, pre-run expectations and all-case comparisons exceed assignment counts.90-run/k=3 shadow acceptance and strict comparison gates are self-imposed. Failed model decisions and declined expensive reruns are not automatically assignment failures when honestly reported.

findings.finding: Personal review/understanding and independent student authorship cannot be certified by an agent; DESIGN.md:150 explicitly leaves latest review pending.
findings.action: Student reviews the exact final commit and can explain permissions, scripts, outputs, score failures, provenance and AI assistance; update the declaration only after doing so.
findings.grading_implication: Material readiness condition; AI assistance itself is expressly allowed and is not a deduction.

findings.finding: The local archive cannot establish final commit availability on GitHub, eLearn submission, repository visibility or ctreude access.
findings.action: Owner confirms remote commit, chooses that exact commit URL, submits one link in eLearn, and grants ctreude collaborator access if private.
findings.grading_implication: Administrative/access requirements can prevent marking; currently unverified, not evidence of noncompliance.

findings.finding: Weekly provider drift checks remain explicitly proposed; deterministic CI cannot detect provider model drift. The cited cost/deferred-run rationale explains not buying a full hosted rerun, but does not expressly adopt an ongoing manual drift gate or say why recurring detection is unnecessary now.
findings.action: Owner-approved wording should define manual golden review before any reactivation/model/configuration change, or explain why recurring live monitoring is unnecessary while operation is limited/deferred. State which outputs are reviewed and by whom. No new scheduled paid workflow is required.
findings.grading_implication: A modest-to-material literal implement-or-explain completeness risk. The four matrix rows represent one underlying issue, not four deductions.

findings.finding: Opening text and earlier-only retrieval are reconstructed, but historical checkout exposure, present-day author association, hindsight-informed gold selection and component hints limit independence. Current checkout filtering leaves Git history and is not a full isolation boundary.
findings.action: Preserve honest scope; do not retroactively call old results clean/blind or retune frozen expectations. The18 fresh historical candidate cases mitigate this concern. Any stronger generalisation claim needs further genuinely independent opening-only evaluation, not relabelling existing runs.
findings.grading_implication: Prevents strong causal/generalisation claims. Existing disclosure is good scientific practice but cannot erase historical validity limitations.

findings.finding: Current exact hosted runtime has five selected ordinary cases, while attacks/forced enforcement are historical and newer negative guards are tested offline. Current policy also has60 fresh dry-run decisions; this should not be omitted.
findings.action: Keep source versions and tested/configured/proposed scope clear. A few targeted current guard tests could strengthen assurance if separately authorised, but neither90 paid runs nor universal perfect decisions are assignment minimums.
findings.grading_implication: Residual top-band confidence limit, not an automatic assignment failure or proof of unsafe behaviour.
